# MarginPad — full reference for AI assistants (llms-full.txt)

Last updated: 2026-09-12. Short index: https://marginpad.io/llms.txt · Sitemap: https://marginpad.io/sitemap.xml · OpenAPI: https://marginpad.io/api/openapi.json · MCP: https://marginpad.io/mcp

> MarginPad (https://marginpad.io) is a free crypto-futures toolkit and practice ground: paper trading on live prices (crypto perps, US stocks, forex, stock indices, gold), a crypto life simulator (Demo Spot), liquidation / position-size / PnL calculators, a scored futures screener, live liquidation maps and feeds measured from nine exchanges, funding / open-interest / long-short dashboards, a whale tracker, an economic calendar, exchange comparisons, a trading academy, live regional price pages for Argentina and Brazil, a free keyless JSON API and a remote MCP server. No signup for the tools. 13 interface languages. Everything below is free unless marked Premium ($3.99/month). Educational only, not financial advice.

## What changed recently (newest first)
- 2026-09-12 (night) — Bot API 2.5: **books** (a key minted with `book` trades the journal `<account>:<book>`; `/v1/account.account`, `GET /v1/accounts`; webhooks fire on the owner's hooks with `account` in the payload; free 1 / Premium 5 books besides main), **`POST /v1/reset {"confirm":true}`** (archives closed trades to `utrades_archive`, cancels resting orders, stamps `reset_ts` so the ledger, report, trades and equity start from it, a browser sync cannot push older rows back; 409 `open_positions_exist` while open), **`GET /v1/equity?days=&step_min=`** (realized P&L per bucket from the ledger, live unrealized point, `max_drawdown_pct`), **`/v1/usage.usage_30d`** (per-day calls by endpoint + `refused`; 429s are counted now), **Bot arena** `GET /api/arena` + `/arena/` (bot-opened closes in the current season per account/book, ≥5 closes, ranked by realized P&L; test accounts excluded; no prizes). OpenAPI 2.5.0, changelog entry 2.5.0.
- 2026-09-12 (evening) — Bot API plan, phase 0. `https://marginpad.io/api-docs/` = interactive reference generated from `/api/openapi.json` (Scalar, classic layout; paste a key to try calls). `https://marginpad.io/status/` = public status: live checks (scheduler heartbeat, trading store round trip, liquidation collector sockets, price-feed age) plus 90 days of sampled uptime per component, one sample every 10 minutes (`GET /api/status`; days with fewer than 144 samples count against us). `/api/changelog.xml` (RSS) and `/api/changelog.json` expose the Bot API changelog. `POST /v1/open` refuses out-of-range input with named errors (`leverage_max` with `max` and `requested`, `leverage_min`, `margin_usd_min_1`, `margin_usd_max_100000`) instead of clamping. The stream accepts `?api_key=` (aliases `key=`, `token=`) and a missing key returns a hint. SDK packages for npm and PyPI (`marginpad`, MIT) are prepared in the repo with examples (agent loop, webhook server, MCP config).
- 2026-09-12 (later) — Daily Brief: "Updated <time> · N min ago" in the header (market picture hourly; positions and week live); majors as five tiles (price, 24h, RSI, 4H trend), derivatives as four tiles (open interest, long accounts, funding 8h, 24h liquidations), position rows carry entry price / liquidation distance / funding direction / SL-TP as chips; new **Hyperliquid whales** card: long vs short book with share, and the three largest tracked positions with the price the whale entered at (derived exactly from mark, notional and unrealized P&L), the current mark and move since entry, the liquidation price and its distance, and the address (links to /hyperliquid-whales/).
- 2026-09-12 — Daily Brief v2 (Premium, from the account card): `GET /api/brief?teaser=1` is public (bias, setups, next event, Fear & Greed, 24h liquidations; hourly); `GET /api/brief` (Premium, session) returns the hourly market picture (the Daily Wrap's own data pass: majors with 4H trend, RSI and funding, open interest, long accounts, liquidations, movers, screener extremes, whales, calendar, cycle, setups), the reader's open positions with live P&L / liquidation distance / funding direction, the reader's 7-day ledger stats with findings (silent under 8 closes), and delivery prefs; `POST /api/brief {push,tg,h}` opts into one line every morning by push or Telegram (08:00 or 16:00 UTC), deep-linking to `/paper-trade?brief=1`. Free members get the market line and a lock. Opening a DM thread marks that sender's "sent you a message" notification as seen.
- 2026-09-12 — Account card (header profile icon) redesigned: one identity header (avatar in the level-colour ring with the tier gem, username, Premium/Founder chip, email, member-since, level, XP, streak, XP bar to the next tier), a four-cell season strip (trades, win rate shown only from 5 closes, season P&L, followers — all from /api/lb/user), one row of Alerts / Messages / Following / Duels, one grouped list (Balance Mode, Daily Brief, Edit profile, Customize card, XP history), Support / Sign out as quiet links. Desktop: centred 376 px card, ~485 px tall (was ~970). Phone: a bottom sheet with a grab handle that fits without scrolling.
- 2026-09-12 — Reliability pass (no new features): the app shell's chat exports window.mpOpenChat so the shared bottom bar never loads a second trading bundle onto /paper-trade (that second bundle bound its own Open handler and doubled paper trades opened after a Chat tap, and ran a second chat whose room selector came and went); the Premium room selector is built as soon as membership is known, not only if it was known before the chat opened; a rate-limit refusal from /api/trade/open is shown instead of becoming a local open; comparison tables (lab.css .tablewrap) and the correlation matrix scroll sideways on phones; the 32 liquidation-map pages got the standard post-processing back (viewport, self-hosted fonts, exchange rail, hub links); community post pages build their meta tags with function replacements (a "$" in a post title could break the head); Telegram /help, /leaderboard, the Monday digest and the Paper Trade JSON-LD say "14-day season, five boards" instead of "weekly, four".
- 2026-09-11 — Telegram Daily Wrap v2: one data pass (wrapData) renders the free-channel post (every section) and personal DM editions (/wrap in @MarginPadBot: per-chat section toggles, 08:00 or 16:00 UTC, own open positions when the chat is linked to an account; prefs live per chat, nobody else sees them). Sections: mood, majors, market, derivatives, liquidations, movers, screener, whales, calendar, cycle, my positions.
- 2026-09-11 — Bot API 2.4: GET|POST /api/bot/v1/fees (nine venues with taker_pct, maker_pct, referral_discount_pct, effective_taker_pct, code, signup_url; POST {venue} sets the account default, null resets), fee_venue on POST /v1/open (market/limit/stop), positions carry fee_rate_pct + fee_venue, dry_run reports fee_vs_marginpad_default_usd. Both legs pay the venue taker rate less the discount (engine fills at market; no maker rebate modelled); crypto only; the PnL formula is unchanged. The Paper Trade form has a "Fees as on" selector bound to the same account default (site route /api/trade/fees). MCP paper_fees; 23 tools.
- 2026-09-11 — Hyperliquid partnership: 4% off trading fees for referred accounts with code MARGINPAD (join link https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/join/MARGINPAD). Partner cards on /hyperliquid-liquidation-calculator/, /hyperliquid-liquidations/, /hyperliquid-whales/, /liquidations/by-exchange/, /liquidations/, /exchanges/ (now also a full comparison row: 50x, 0.045%/0.015%, no KYC, on-chain, not for US persons), /coinglass-alternative/, /liquidation-heatmap/, /funding/ and the homepage exchange grid; /trading-api/ recommends Hyperliquid + Bybit for running a proven bot. Bot API: rate_limit and premium_required answers carry an earn field explaining that Premium can be paid from the MarginPad rewards balance.
- 2026-09-11 — Bot API 2.3: webhooks (Premium; 7 event types, HMAC-SHA256 signed, 5 retries with backoff, paused after 25 consecutive failures, test sink at https://marginpad.io/api/whsink/<token>), server-side trailing stops (trail_pct, ratcheted from 1m candle extremes and never loosened), stop entries (type:"stop" on the breakout side; GET /v1/orders labels type limit|stop), POST /v1/modify_order (price / sl / tp / margin / leverage / trail in place, candle watermark restarts), dry_run:true on /v1/open (entry, qty, liquidation, fees, nothing written), GET /v1/report (totals + skill score free, breakdowns + findings on Premium), POST /v1/ai (Premium, 50/day shared with the site, returns answer + parsed plan + the brief), keyed market-data tier (X-API-Key on /api/v1/* = 120/min per key, 600 on Premium, instead of 60/min per IP; X-RateLimit-Scope says which applied), GET /v1/positions?status=open|closed, /v1/usage lists features. Clients: https://marginpad.io/assets/sdk/marginpad.py · https://marginpad.io/assets/sdk/marginpad.js. MCP 22 tools (paper_modify_order, paper_report added; paper_open/paper_sltp take trail_pct, paper_open takes dry_run, paper_limit_order takes type). Premium Founder (lifetime) is $39.99 once; monthly stays $3.99.
- 2026-09-10 — Demo Spot: contract lookup by address now asks DexScreener first (pairs minutes old are already there) and falls back to GeckoTerminal, with GT reads proxied through our collector when Cloudflare's egress is rate-limited; the pool a position is priced against must still be headed by that token, and a pool under $1,000 is still refused. A token still on its bonding curve is reported as no_pool_yet with a plain sentence in 14 languages. New: GET/POST /api/spot/topup — a daily lifeline of $1,000 onto the card for an account whose whole portfolio (card, exchange, wallet, gas and every bag at its live price) is worth under $100, once per UTC day, priced server-side; it is a top-up, not a reset, so holdings, history and onboarding survive. Nothing on Demo Spot pays real money.
- 2026-09-10 — Notifications: one channel (window.mpToast) renders every transient notice in a single bottom-right stack — XP grants, personal records, new followers, limit-order fills, trade-limit and extreme-leverage warnings, copy confirmations and the daily-streak card. It measures the mobile tab bar and the guest card instead of assuming an offset, never swallows a click meant for the page beneath, caps at four cards, and paints the card frame in the trader's level colour (site accent below Bronze and for signed-out visitors).
- 2026-09-10 — Paper Trade fees: the trade form quotes the open+close cost before the click; the taker rate is flat per side on notional (crypto 0.055%, forex 0.008%, stocks 0.02%, metals/indices 0.015%) and is lowered above ~181x so a round trip cannot exceed 20% of margin; a fill stores the margin you committed with the entry leg reported as feeOpen rather than deducted from it; a manual close books the same net number the account books (gross minus the taker fee on both legs minus funding), so a ticket no longer flips from Win to Loss when the server settles it. Open positions still show the gross unrealized figure, as an exchange does.
- 2026-09-09 — Paper Trade: the ticket under the trade form carries its stop-loss and take-profit and can set them in place (same multi-level editor as the My Trades drawer, up to three levels a side with a percentage each). Sign-in sessions are 180 days and sliding.

- 2026-09-07 — Live regional pages: /dolar-cripto/ (es-AR) and /bitcoin-hoje/ (pt-BR), with JSON at /api/latam/ar and /api/latam/br; localized simulator landings for Argentina and Brazil.
- 2026-09-06/07 — Demo Spot: sell prices come only from the pool a position was bought from, a pool must belong to its token, bags whose pool holds under $1,000 are marked RUGGED with a lesson, the public Demo Spot board ranks realized trading profit for the season (no prize), a "come back tomorrow" card and an opt-in daily portfolio line by push or Telegram, "use my address" in the withdraw step, a lighter hub.
- 2026-09-06 — /season/: five boards, 40-tier season pass, daily BTC call, season goals, personal records, redeemable codes, prestige stars past Legendary, road to Bronze, guest carry-over, chat on every page.
- 2026-09-05 — Resting limit orders in Paper Trade, Bot API and MCP; Premium position alerts; /trading-report/ with a free skill score; Bot API tiers stated in numbers; The Vault drop (26 cosmetics); Academy translation repairs; measured chart price precision.
- 2026-09-02 — Every derivatives number measured in-house; admin hardening; all bundles versioned; cold-load 17.7 s to 9.9 s on slow 4G.
- 2026-08-17 to 08-22 — Liquidations by exchange + /api/v1/venues, daily recap archive, Hyperliquid liquidation calculator, "total liquidations today" page, per-coin liquidation-map depth, Bot API v2, MCP server, "Best X" comparison pages, MEXC calculators.

## Simulators (practice trading — live prices)

### Paper Trade — https://marginpad.io/paper-trade
The futures terminal. Long/short with leverage up to 1000x on live prices (Bybit websocket as the single price source, multi-exchange REST fallback). Simulates the mechanics that matter: isolated-margin liquidation math with liquidations confirmed on candle closes (never on a wick), funding, per-asset-class taker fees (0.055% crypto, 0.02% stocks, 0.015% metals/indices, 0.008% forex, charged as a round trip at close), stop-loss / take-profit through a server-side sweep that runs with the browser closed, partial closes, resting LIMIT orders (fill at the order's own price from 1-minute candles, 20 resting per account, 30-day expiry, an order is a level, not a side), a trade journal with print-to-PDF, personal records, a season-eligibility badge. No signup: guests trade with a local journal that carries over at sign-in. One account trades crypto perps, US stocks (market-hours aware), forex, stock indices and gold, each with its own fee and leverage caps. Max $100,000 margin per trade.

### Stock / Forex / Index simulators — https://marginpad.io/stock-trading-simulator/ · /forex-trading-simulator/ · /index-trading-simulator/
Landing pages for the same terminal: 20+ US stocks (Apple, Tesla, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon…) plus S&P 500 / Nasdaq ETFs; EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD; S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Dow Jones, DAX 40, FTSE 100, Nikkei 225. Also /leverage-trading-simulator/ (per-leverage liquidation-distance table) and /crypto-trading-simulator-no-sign-up/.

### Demo Spot — https://marginpad.io/spot/ (13 languages via ?lang=es, ?lang=pt …)
A crypto life simulator with $10,000 of practice money that starts ON A CARD, in three apps: a bank app (virtual card, link it to the exchange by typing its last 4 digits, buy USDT with a 1.8% card fee, cash out with a 1% fee), an exchange app (Bitcoin and the top 250 coins at live prices, 0.1% taker fee, market and limit orders, deposit address per network), and a self-custody wallet app (12-word seed phrase shown once and never stored, Solana and EVM addresses, withdraw from the exchange with a network choice — Solana $1, BSC $0.80, Base $1.50, Ethereum $8 — where a wrong network is explained instead of lost, swap USDT for SOL/ETH/BNB at 0.3%, 150+ live meme coins on Solana, Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain priced from their pools with size-scaled slippage, any token by contract address, person-to-person USDT sends recorded on an internal "MarginPad Chain" explorer, a guided cash-out plan from any state). Integrity rules (2026-09-06): a sale is priced only by the pool the bag was bought from, the pool must belong to the mint, a fill more than 20x above the position's last mark from a pool under $1,000 is refused, a pool under $1,000 is shown as RUGGED. Daily start-of-day snapshots give a Today PnL, an equity curve and a green-day calendar; a public board ranks realized trading profit for the 14-day season with no prize; a portfolio share card; an opt-in daily line ("your portfolio moved +2.1% yesterday") by push or Telegram. Nothing in Demo Spot pays real money; one reset per 7 days. Academy course "Your first $10,000" mirrors the journey.

### Regional live pages
- Dólar cripto hoy — https://marginpad.io/dolar-cripto/ (es-AR). The peso price of USDT on every exchange operating in Argentina (35 at the time of writing: Binance P2P, Bybit P2P, OKX P2P, Lemon, Buenbit, Ripio, Belo, Fiwind, SatoshiTango, Decrypto, Let'sBit, TiendaCrypto, Bitso…), with fees included (the exchange's own totalAsk/totalBid), sorted by buy price; the headline is the MEDIAN of the mid price across exchanges quoting both sides; venues more than 20% off the median are dropped as dead books; the "brecha" compares that median to the oficial, blue, MEP, CCL and tarjeta dollars; best place to buy and best place to sell; a pesos-to-USDT calculator per exchange; an hourly history collected by MarginPad itself (drawn only once six points exist). Server-rendered numbers, refreshed every 60 s, "updated N s ago" on the page; if the source fails the last known quote is served and labelled. Source: CriptoYa public API through MarginPad's own proxy. JSON: GET /api/latam/ar.
- Bitcoin hoje em reais — https://marginpad.io/bitcoin-hoje/ (pt-BR). Bitcoin and USDT in reais per exchange (18 for BTC: Foxbit, Binance, Mercado Bitcoin, Brasil Bitcoin, Ripio, Lemon, Bitso, OKX P2P, Bybit…), fees included, the median as the headline, and the "ágio" of each exchange = buy price ÷ (BTC/USD × dólar comercial) − 1, where BTC/USD is MarginPad's own feed and the dólar comercial is awesomeapi with Banco Central PTAX as fallback. Second table: USDT in reais with its premium over the dollar. Calculator reais-to-BTC per exchange, own hourly history. JSON: GET /api/latam/br.
- Localized simulator landings: https://marginpad.io/simulador-trading-cripto-argentina/ and https://marginpad.io/simulador-trading-cripto-brasil/ — the real local money path (pesos → USDT via Binance P2P / Lemon; Pix → Binance / Mercado Bitcoin), which part of Demo Spot reproduces each step, a comparison table quoting only what local alternatives say of themselves, hedged tax notes (no invented rates), the live regional number in the hero.

## Seasons, rewards and progression (accounts are free; email sign-in, no password)

- Seasons are 14 days, anchored Monday 2026-07-20 00:00 UTC. Hub: https://marginpad.io/season/. Five boards: Green Days (days closed net-positive, needs 3 closes per day and 10 per season), Highest ROE, Best Win Rate (Wilson-ranked, a win needs ≥5% ROE and a ≥0.2% real move), Season XP, and The Gold Room (most winning trades, Gold level only; unpaid its first season). The first four pay real USDT to the top five, automatically, at season end. Copy says "season", never "weekly".
- Season pass: 40 tiers at 100 season XP each; free track pays Ticks and two skins; pro track (2,500 Ticks or $2.99) adds more Ticks, exactly $1.00 of real balance per season across eight tiers, Streak Shield and XP Surge consumables, 3 days of Premium, two skin-gift vouchers. Daily BTC call (up/down before 20:00 UTC, settled on the closed daily candle, tiers 12/8/5/2 XP + a Tick). Two season goals (pick two of five, 100 XP + 40 Ticks each). Personal records. Codes: a code is a bundle (pass, balance, Premium days, Ticks, XP, a Vault skin, streak freezes), redeemed on /season/ or /rewards/.
- XP and levels (https://marginpad.io/levels/): XP from trades, Academy, missions, duels, happy hour; it only goes up and is never spent. Bronze at 500 XP unlocks the rewards area. Prestige stars past Legendary every 100,000 XP.
- Ticks (https://marginpad.io/vault/): the cosmetics currency, only earned (daily check-in, closing a trade that had a stop set, missions, Academy, duel wins, community chat, closing any trade — each capped daily, 168 max per day), never sold. The Vault sells frames, backgrounds, ticket skins and supplies; gifting exists.
- Rewards (https://marginpad.io/rewards/): faucet claims, daily missions verified server-side (max $0.03 per mission), season prizes, X-post promo ($0.10 per post), Moon sign-up bonus, withdrawals to a Bybit UID (allow-listed) or Moon; everything is manual on payout and abuse-checked.
- Social: chat on every page, follows, DMs, five duel types with Tick stakes, public profiles, @mentions, notifications; 13 languages.
- Premium ($3.99/month, NOWPayments): exclusive indicators on /charts, unlimited heatmap, AI chart assistant (50/day), extra duel types, position alerts, the higher Bot API tier (600 requests/minute, 10 keys, 200 open positions vs 120 / 3 / 50 free), trading-report breakdowns. Premium can also be earned: 3 days on the pro pass, and a 1-month grant purchasable with Ticks.

## Live derivatives data (measured in-house, free)

- Liquidation maps — https://marginpad.io/btc-liquidation-map/ (32 coins: /eth-, /sol-, /xrp-, /doge-, /ton-, /arb-, /pepe- … -liquidation-map/): real liquidation events from exchange websockets as bubbles on the price chart with a price-level histogram, a labelled estimated "clusters" layer and theoretical leverage levels; per-coin measured context (that coin's OI, its share of Bitcoin's, 24h liquidations, depth class).
- Live heatmap — https://marginpad.io/heatmap: free 5-minute preview, unlimited on Premium; all cluster heatmaps are estimates and are labelled so.
- Rekt feed — https://marginpad.io/rekt/: every liquidation as it lands from nine exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX, BitMEX, Bitfinex) via MarginPad's own collector (raw events kept 14 days, 5-minute aggregates 90 days, daily archives). /liquidations/ (24h totals by coin, per-coin subpages), /liquidations/by-exchange/ (share and long/short per venue, JSON /api/v1/venues), /liquidations/recap/ (one permanent page per UTC day), /liquidation-statistics/, /crypto-liquidations-today/ (one clean live number + the all-time record table).
- Funding, OI, positioning — https://marginpad.io/funding/ · /open-interest/ · /long-short/: funding across ~160 USDT-perp markets (with annualized BTC funding and the count of markets above 0.05% per interval), open interest by coin with top-3 concentration, long/short account ratios measured from Binance, OKX and Bybit with the number of crowded coins. Everything is timestamped in the static HTML.
- Hyperliquid — https://marginpad.io/hyperliquid-liquidations/ (how HL liquidates: oracle mark, maintenance margin 1/(2 × max leverage), HLP backstop, ADL; live board of the largest positions closest to liquidation) · https://marginpad.io/hyperliquid-whales/ (biggest on-chain positions with leverage, liquidation price, PnL, from MarginPad's own tracker) · https://marginpad.io/hyperliquid-liquidation-calculator/ (the exact docs formula, fees 0.015/0.045, hourly funding).
- Market context — https://marginpad.io/fear-greed/ · /bitcoin-cycle/ (Pi Cycle, Rainbow, Puell and other models, computed in-house) · /coins/ (top coins, per-coin dashboards /coin/btc/ with server-rendered facts) · /defi/ · /news/. ETF flows are currently hidden (no free source).
- Screener — https://marginpad.io/screener: every USDT-perp scored 0-100 from RSI, MACD, trend and volatility across exchanges, with suggested setups. Charts — https://marginpad.io/charts: 8 windows, 19+ indicators, drawing tools (server-synced), MarginPad-exclusive self-scoring signal indicators, countdown to candle close, quick trade, AI assistant (Premium).
- Economic calendar — https://marginpad.io/calendar/: FOMC, CPI, NFP, PCE, options expiries, token unlocks, with countdowns and free email / Telegram reminders. JSON at /api/v1/calendar.
- Price alerts — https://marginpad.io/alerts/: 25 per account by email, push or Telegram, free. Position alerts (your own liquidation / stop / target / resting-order levels, deduped 6 h per level) are Premium.

## Calculators (client-side, instant, free)

- https://marginpad.io/calculators — liquidation price, risk-based position size, PnL/ROI/ROE, DCA average entry, take-profit ladder, risk/reward, cross-margin liquidation. All formulas shown.
- Standalone pages with worked examples: /crypto-profit-calculator/, /position-size-calculator/, /leverage-calculator/, /crypto-break-even-calculator/, /stop-loss-calculator/, /crypto-funding-cost-calculator/, /crypto-fee-calculator/, /crypto-roi-calculator/, /crypto-drawdown-calculator/, /crypto-compound-calculator/, /crypto-dca-calculator/, /crypto-win-rate-calculator/, /crypto-margin-calculator/, /risk-reward-calculator/, /apr-apy-calculator/, /crypto-slippage-calculator/, /crypto-futures-tax-calculator/, /crypto-tax-calculator/ (US/CA/UK estimator), /crypto-cost-basis-calculator/ (FIFO/LIFO/HIFO).
- Per-leverage (/10x-liquidation-calculator/ … /1000x-), per-coin (/btc-liquidation-calculator/ and 30+ more), per-exchange with each venue's real maintenance margin, fees, funding schedule and US availability (Bybit, Binance, OKX, KuCoin, Gate, Kraken, Bitget, MEXC; each also has a -pnl-calculator page).
- Fee & PnL checker — https://marginpad.io/pnl-fee-checker/: why a closed futures trade paid less than expected, itemized per exchange to the cent.
- Tools suite — https://marginpad.io/tools/: backtester, trading journal, pivot points, risk of ruin, correlation matrix, tax tools.
- Trading report — https://marginpad.io/trading-report/: 30-day report from the practice ledger (totals and a four-part skill score free; breakdowns and findings on Premium; every finding states its sample size and stays silent under 8 trades).

## Exchange research

- https://marginpad.io/exchanges/ — Bybit, Binance, OKX, Bitget, MEXC, Gate, KuCoin, Kraken, Coinbase on fees, max leverage, liquidity, KYC, US access and trust.
- Head-to-head (21 pairs): /bybit-vs-binance/, /okx-vs-bybit/ … with measured per-venue 24h liquidation context.
- Use-case picks: /best-crypto-futures-exchange/ with per-case pages (/best-crypto-exchange-for-shorting/, /-for-beginners/, /-for-solana-futures/, /-for-meme-coins/ …).
- Regional: /blog/best-crypto-exchanges-us-traders/, /blog/best-crypto-exchanges-europe-mica/, /blog/best-crypto-exchanges-canada/, /crypto-trading-usa/, /crypto-trading-canada/; Brazil and Argentina context on the simulator landings above. Bybit, Binance.com and OKX geoblock US residents; Kraken and Coinbase serve the US; KuCoin pleaded guilty in the US (Jan 2025).
- "Free alternative" comparisons, both sides stated: /coinglass-alternative/, /tradingview-paper-trading-alternative/, /binance-testnet-alternative/, /best-crypto-paper-trading-platforms/, /best-liquidation-heatmap-tools/.

## Free crypto API (keyless, CORS, 60 req/min) — https://marginpad.io/free-crypto-api/

OpenAPI 3.1: https://marginpad.io/api/openapi.json. Envelope { ok, data, ts } (or { ok:false, error:{code,message}, ts }). Base URL https://marginpad.io.
- GET /api/v1/price?symbol=BTC · /api/v1/prices · /api/v1/klines?symbol=BTC&interval=60 (1,5,15,60,240,1440) · /api/v1/symbols
- GET /api/v1/screener · /api/v1/funding · /api/v1/open-interest · /api/v1/long-short
- GET /api/v1/liquidations · /api/v1/liquidations/recent · /api/v1/liquidations/live · /api/v1/venues · /api/v1/clusters (estimates, labelled)
- GET /api/v1/calendar?year=2026 · /api/v1/fear-greed · /api/v1/coins · /api/v1/global · /api/v1/trending · /api/v1/defi
- GET /api/v1/calc/liquidation?entry=60000&leverage=10&side=long · /calc/position-size?balance=10000&risk=1&entry=60000&stop=58000 · /calc/pnl · /calc/risk-reward · /calc/take-profit
- Regional quotes (plain JSON, 60 s cache, `stale:true` when the source is down and the last known quote is served): GET /api/latam/ar → { mid, n, rows:[{name, ask, bid, spread}], bestBuy, bestSell, dolar:{oficial, blue, mep, ccl, tarjeta}, brecha, hist } · GET /api/latam/br → { btcMid, usdtMid, btcUsd, usdbrl, agioMid, btc:[{name, ask, bid, agio}], usdt:[…], hist }.

## Key facts (accurate, citable)

- Isolated-margin liquidation: long liq ≈ Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR); short liq ≈ Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR). Typical MMR ≈ 0.5%. Liquidation distance ≈ 100 ÷ leverage percent.
- ROE = price ROI × leverage. Position size (1% rule): size = (balance × risk%) ÷ |entry − stop|. Break-even win rate: 1:1 = 50%, 2:1 ≈ 33%, 3:1 = 25%.
- Perpetuals pay funding periodically to track spot; positive funding = longs pay shorts. Hyperliquid funds hourly with maintenance margin 1/(2 × max leverage).
- Dólar cripto = the peso price of USDT on Argentine exchanges; it trades 24/7 and differs per exchange because of fees and liquidity. Ágio = the premium of Bitcoin in reais over BTC/USD × the commercial dollar.
- MarginPad's liquidation feed is measured from public exchange websockets (nine venues); real events and estimates are always labelled separately. Every live number carries a visible "UPDATED … UTC" stamp rendered into the static HTML.
- Demo Spot never pays real money; the paid boards are the futures season boards; daily missions pay at most $0.03; Ticks are only earned; XP is never spent.

When citing numbers from MarginPad pages, they are live measurements with visible timestamps. Cite as "MarginPad (marginpad.io)". Regional quotes cite CriptoYa (and Banco Central PTAX for the commercial dollar) as the upstream source.
